[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Thomas's inherited birth year is about 1783, but the year is unverified. The possible 1782 Wandell and Lamington baptism below remains a comparison rather than an assigned event; the uncertain year does not exclude it.

== Research Notes ==
=== Earlier date and family account ===

The earlier biography stated: Thomas was born in 1783.

Those inherited claims remain in the research account, but have not been established by the record comparison made here.

=== Wandell and Lamington baptism comparison ===

A Findmypast derivative transcript records Thomas Glasgow baptised on 3 November 1782 at Wandell and Lamington, Lanarkshire, with father William Glasgow and no mother supplied. This is a candidate baptism for Thomas, not an established identification.<ref>Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_684963042 Scotland, Parish Births &amp; Baptisms 1564–1929, Thomas Glasgow], baptism 3 November 1782, Wandell and Lamington, Lanarkshire; father William Glasgow; mother’s first name shown as “-”. Provider derivative transcript inspected 30 October 2026; original register not inspected.</ref>

The baptism precedes Thomas’s uncertain 1783 birth year by about a year. That discrepancy needs checking; the uncertain year does not by itself exclude this identification. The transcript’s birth-year field does not supply an exact birth date. Its blank maternal field neither excludes [[Affleck-597|Unknown (Affleck) Glasgow]] nor confirms her as this child’s mother. The named father has not been identified with an adult profile.

The Thomas baptism of 3 November 1782 and William baptism of 19 September 1784 share a parish and a father’s name. Those details do not establish that the children were full siblings or that their fathers were the same man.<ref>Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_684963042 Thomas Glasgow, baptism 3 November 1782] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_684962615 William Glasgow, baptism 19 September 1784], Wandell and Lamington, Scotland, Parish Births &amp; Baptisms 1564–1929. Both derivative transcripts name father William Glasgow and supply no mother; originals not inspected.</ref> The original parish entries and the later death entries may provide identifying details.

The Scotland’s People link below leads to search results rather than a record-specific death entry. Its underlying evidence for the stated dates and maternal attribution has not been inspected in this review.
